content.summary: Cash management services provider Brink's (NYSE:BCO) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 6.1% year on year to $1.34 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $1.36 billion, coming in 0.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.08 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
